headline: Why Becton Dickinson (BDX) Is Up 6.8% After Q3 Beat And GLP-1 Delivery Partnerships
summary: Becton, Dickinson and Company recently reported third-quarter fiscal 2026 results, with sales rising to US$4,983 million while net income fell to US$377 million, and modestly raised its full-year outlook for low single-digit plus GAAP revenue growth. Alongside these earnings, BD highlighted strong momentum in biologic drug delivery and GLP-1–related partnerships, including a new semaglutide pen collaboration with EMS in Brazil, underscoring the growing role of its Vystra Injection Pen...

headline: Becton Dickinson (BDX) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Lift After Mixed Analyst Views
summary: Becton Dickinson has seen its analyst fair value estimate move from US$181.23 to US$189.58, signaling a refreshed price target framework that investors are watching closely. This shift reflects how recent research is weighing the solid fiscal Q3 beat, product updates, and mixed views on 2027 utilization and margin risk.
